infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: REAUX Labs uses your camera to let you take a photo in the app — for example, to snap a picture of yourself to set as your profile avatar or to attach a gym photo to a community post.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: REAUX Labs uses your photo library to let you choose photos and videos to share in the app — for example, to pick a photo to set as your profile avatar, attach an image to a community post, or select a workout video to publish as a reel.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: REAUX Labs uses your microphone when you record a video with sound in the app — for example, to record a workout reel with audio to share with the community.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: REAUX Labs uses Face ID to confirm it's you before unlocking your securely saved login session on this device, so you don't have to re-enter your password.
